notes.title: Wardwell House is now FREE
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone, 

We've made Wardwell House completely free for all users.  We greatly appreciate everyone that has played this game and would love for new users to try it.  If you like this game, be sure to try our other games "8/8/88 Needle AL" which is in the same style as this and our new survival-horror game, "The Holyburn Witches"

Thank you guys,
Moolion Team

notes.title: New game announcement
notes.notes:
[h2]The big news
[/h2]Our brand new game "The Holyburn Witches" is releasing on Jan 5, 2024!  It's a unique survival-horror game with the similar eerie atmosphere of Wardwell House and 8/8/88 Needle AL.  Unlike our other games, this is all about gameplay and doesn't involve only reading.

[h2] Game description:
[/h2]You are all alone in the forests near the derelict town of Holyburn, Maine.  Legend has it that unexplained horrific events took place in this town in the early 1900s.  You must survive 4 days and 4 nights without losing your life or sanity.  Collect enough firewood and mushrooms and remember, do NOT let the bonfire go out at night.

[h2]Link to the Steam page:
[/h2] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2645600/The_Holyburn_Witches/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2645600/The_Holyburn_Witches/[/url]

notes.title: New game announcement
notes.notes:
We're excited to announce our new game "8/8/88 Needle AL".  It's about to leave Early Access soon so you we're running a 50% sale on it.  You can grab the full game now for just $0.99 instead of the full price of $4.99 when it goes live.  

Our new game has the same creepy and eerie atmosphere of Wardwell House, but with a much deeper story and a longer experience.  The short description of the game: 

"On the ominous date of 8/8/1888, the entire population of Needle, Alabama seemingly vanished, leaving behind only a haunting silence and an eerie sense of dread. A first-person psychological-horror drama".

Here is the link to the Steam page:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1949370/8888_Needle_AL/]8/8/88 Needle AL steam page[/url]

notes.title: Wardwell House visual and control update
notes.notes: To celebrate the Early Access release of our new game "8/8/88 Needle AL", we decided to improve the control scheme and increase the resolution for Wardwell House.  This is the best version of the game so if you haven't tried it before, please enjoy it now and hit us up with your feedback.
